design_notes: Use serif font throughout; single accent colour (e.g., dark blue) for table headers and pull-quote rule.
Financial tables: hairline rules, right-align numbers, left-align labels.
Pull-quote: set in larger serif italic, with a thin rule above and below, accent colour for the opening quotation mark.
Sidebar: box with a thin border, background tint (light grey), title in small caps.

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Customer concentration. Indian Railways — primarily Western Railway — contributed 57% of revenue in Fiscal 2018 and 52% of orders on hand.
pull_quotes.quote: Majority of our revenues will be dependent on one customer, Indian Railways, which is our largest customer, contributing to 57% of our revenue in Fiscal 2018.
